scope: Local contribution-level deduplication for the BigMac2 repository addition. This is not a new mathematical referee report or an external novelty judgment. Each existing canonical PDF is retained unchanged.
selection_rule: Use only each BigMac2 project current gated release. For the five duplicate mathematical results, retain the already-present canonical paper rather than choosing by filesystem modification date; preserve alias and gate/hash provenance. Source trees from different manuscripts must not be mislabeled as matching.
comparison_basis: Frozen claim statements, BigMac2 LaTeX theorem text, existing repository PDF theorem text and catalog, prior topic relationships, exact file hashes, and explicit graph isomorphisms. Related topics with genuinely different proved scope remain separate.

aliases.reason: Both prove strict planar Firey L2 Rogers–Shephard inequality for every genuine centrally symmetric hexagon, with every admissible origin placement. Both use a complete affine zonotope parametrization and placement convexity followed by exact area calculation. Neither covers p != 2 or more general convex bodies. No enlarged theorem scope was found in the BigMac manuscript.
aliases.recommendation: omit BigMac duplicate PDF and its separate main catalog package; retain existing canonical PDF, record BigMac alias and gate/hash provenance; never pair a BigMac LaTeX tree with the Smallmac PDF as if they compiled together

related_but_retained.reason: BigMac is a complete pure-periodicity / least-period classification for the fixed shape {2,5,c}, including explicit nonpure words. Smallmac proves generic necessity for periods c+a,c+b. A related necessary-condition theorem is not the same as this fixed-shape complete classification.

BigMac certifies v(overline I)<=v(I) in a bounded m-primary 3-variable, <=4-generator degree<=4 layer. Smallmac gives a non-m-primary three-generator counterexample involving x^3 z^4 (degree7). Distinct scope, no conflict.

BigMac domain is Dyck words, primitive two-letter weights |u|,|d|<=2 and either tie order. Smallmac domain is all words with arbitrary finite alphabet/weights. A non-polyregular total-word map may have polyregular restriction; the Dyck negative statements therefore are not logically supplied by the total-word theorem alone.
Different finite Boolean lattices: B3 total cost16 / rdim2 versus B4 total cost42 / rdim21/8.
Different methods/objectives: FGM N2 queried-gradient norm versus two-step unaccelerated GD endpoint function-gap minimax. Do not merge merely because both use PEP.
